title: The University application process | Ep 21: Manchester Voices
description:
Thinking about applying to The University of Manchester? In this episode, students Yasmin, Swarali, Thabisile and Michael open up about their experiences of applying to university, what worried them, what helped them through and how they decided on their courses. They’re joined by Huw from the Student Recruitment team, who explains the application process and answers common questions from applicants.

Chapters:

00:35 When you started your UCAS application, what felt most daunting?
03:09 The Personal Statement has recently changed, what do applicants need to know about the new structured questions?
07:09 Looking back, whats one thing that you were worried about that turned out not to matter as much as you thought? 
09:48 What are the most important things that Admissions Teams are really  looking for in an application?
14:42 What’s next? What happens once someone submits their UCAS application 
19:51 What's one piece of advice you'd give to someone about to start their application to Manchester?

title: Study abroad at the University of Auckland
description: Five international students from US universities share their experiences of studying at the University of Auckland - which is close to everything and has something for everyone. Hear their stories about student life in Auckland and discovering New Zealand's diverse cultural perspectives, welcoming people and beautiful natural scenery - all part of their amazing study abroad experience.
